basic_profile.bio: A seasoned tech enthusiast from the Pacific Northwest, I've been delving into the intricacies of computer hardware and software for over a decade. By day, I'm an IT specialist for a midsize company, and by night, I tinker with electronics in my home workshop. I enjoy unraveling the mysteries of new technologies and sharing my findings with others online. Outside of tech, I have a keen interest in geopolitical strategy games and am an avid reader of science fiction. I'm married and split my free time between gaming and hiking in the beautiful outdoors. I usually hop online in the evenings, especially on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in computer science, having graduated with a degree in the field. Over the years, I've honed my skills through both formal education and hands-on experience in IT roles. I'm particularly interested in network systems and cybersecurity, which I continuously learn about through self-study and online courses.
